items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: He had the band, but they were three different groups

ctx.x: -- well, there were various -- there was [NORMAN PARIS] one band, and I'm trying to think of his name. He's dead now. He had the band, but they were three different groups, because the music was continuous from morning until it closed at night.
And -- oh, it was Warren Chiasson. We were working together. And Charlie Simon was doing the rhythms.
